subject: Demo timing & procurement window — Blue Harbor Q3 spend review
messages:
From: Alexandra Pierce <alexandra@blueharbor.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tim Jenkins <tim.jenkins@blueharbor.com>
Date: 2026-09-18T09:12:00-04:00
Subject: Demo slot — potential conflict with our Q3 freeze

Hi Lauren / Ben,

Thanks again for arranging the demo next week (Sept 23). I need to flag two things from our side:

1) We have a short procurement freeze that begins Sept 22 as leadership finalizes Q3 vendor commitments. Any vendor demos scheduled during the freeze are being deprioritized unless tied to immediate renewals.
2) Our Head of Ops, Tim, will be onsite with a customer from Sept 22–24 and won't be available for the session.

Would it be possible to move the demo to the week of Oct 5 so we can align it with the post-freeze approval window? We still want to proceed — this is timing, not interest. If Oct 5–8 works for you, Tim will clear an hour each day around 10–11am ET.

I'm copying procurement for visibility; they may have a brief checklist to run through before the demo.

Best,
Alexandra
Director, Procurement
Blue Harbor Logistics
[Attachment: BlueHarbor-procurement-window.pdf (PDF)]

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Alexandra Pierce <alexandra@blueharbor.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-18T10:05:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Demo slot — potential conflict with our Q3 freeze

Hi Alexandra — thanks for the heads up. Totally understand the timing constraints.

We can absolutely shift. Two quick items:
- We have an internal pre-demo prep call with engineering the morning of Sept 22; moving is fine as long as we agree on a new window and confirm the attendee list.
- I'll attach an updated demo deck with an optional 30-minute executive summary slide for Tim if he can only join briefly.

Can you confirm whether Oct 6 at 10am ET is an option (Wednesday)? If not, please propose two other 1-hour slots in the Oct 5–8 range and we'll do our best to match.

Lauren
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood-demo-slides-v2.pdf (PDF)]

From: Tim Jenkins <tim.jenkins@blueharbor.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Alexandra Pierce <alexandra@blueharbor.com>
Cc: procurement@blueharbor.com
Date: 2026-09-18T12:30:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Demo slot — potential conflict with our Q3 freeze

Lauren / Alexandra — sorry for the late note. I'm out onsite the 22–24 as Alex mentioned. Oct 6 at 10am ET should be fine from my side; I'll confirm with the Ops team tomorrow but holding that slot for now.

Also, procurement asked me to request a short SOW/draft estimate before the demo so they can do a quick spend-profile check once leadership reconvenes. Appreciate if you can share that.

—Tim
VP Ops, Blue Harbor Logistics

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Tim Jenkins <tim.jenkins@blueharbor.com>, Alexandra Pierce <alexandra@blueharbor.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-19T09:00:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Demo slot — potential conflict with our Q3 freeze

Thanks Tim — attaching a concise SOW and an initial costing range for the configurations we discussed in the discovery call. The SOW is intentionally high-level so procurement can slot it into their review; we can bring a more detailed cost breakdown to the demo if useful.

Proposed slots we can support (all ET):
- Tue Oct 5, 11:00–12:00
- Wed Oct 6, 10:00–11:00 (preferred — aligns with Tim)
- Thu Oct 7, 09:00–10:00

If Oct 6 10am is confirmed, we'll plan for a 45-minute technical demo + 15-minute procurement Q&A.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOW-initial-draft.docx (DOCX)]

From: Alexandra Pierce <alexandra@blueharbor.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Tim Jenkins <tim.jenkins@blueharbor.com>
Cc: procurement@blueharbor.com
Date: 2026-09-19T11:42:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Demo slot — potential conflict with our Q3 freeze

Lauren / Ben — Oct 6 at 10am ET works for our team. Procurement will do a rapid pass on the SOW this afternoon and flag any non-starters, but they noted this timeline is much easier for leadership to consume.

Two asks ahead of the demo:
1) Can you include a 5-slide appendix showing how Redwood handles data retention and audit logs for a VPC/private deployment? Procurement specifically called that out.
2) Please keep the procurement Q&A to 15 minutes — they appreciate concise, bulletized answers.

We will send a calendar invite with confirmed attendees once procurement finishes their pass. Looking forward to it.

Thanks,
Alexandra

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Alexandra Pierce <alexandra@blueharbor.com>, Tim Jenkins <tim.jenkins@blueharbor.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-22T16:05:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Demo slot — confirmed Oct 6 10am ET; prep notes

Perfect — calendar invite received, thanks Alex. A couple quick prep notes for Oct 6: 

- Agenda (45+15): 1) 10' executive overview (Lauren), 2) 30' technical walkthrough + live latency/cost demo (Ben), 3) 15' procurement Q&A (Stephanie).
- Attachments we uploaded to the shared Drive: Redwood-demo-slides-v2.pdf, SOW-initial-draft.docx. I've also added a 5-slide appendix on retention/audit that addresses the VPC/private deployment patterns and KMS/HSM integration.
- Tim: if you can share attendee names for procurement, we'll pin the slides to the top of the deck for the Q&A.

If anything changes on your side because of the leadership freeze, please flag it early and we'll adapt. Otherwise, we'll plan to run the session as scheduled.

See you Oct 6.
Lauren
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Shared link: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/blueharbor-demo-prep]
